description: Land Title Settlement Department - Thudella, Ja-Ela D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 512200 (24/0097)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, locations, ownership details, and land extent measurements. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land title settlement processes, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
